caption: Figure 3. Overview of the training pipeline. Our framework operates in two stages. Base Training (blue and green) establishes independent student-teacher setups for each modality using sparse supervision. Cross-Modal Consistency (orange) introduces our core contribution: bidirectional knowledge transfer where the teacher of one modality supervises the student of the other, weighted by our dual confidence mechanism leveraging prediction certainty and reconstruction quality.
